power.neoorigins.sporeling_mushroom_buff: Na-eweghachi ahụike mgbe ọ nọ na biomes ero.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_fungal_contac: Na-agwọkwa 1 HP kwa sekọnd ọ bụla ka ọ na-eguzo na ma ọ bụ n'ime ero ero ma ọ bụ mycelium.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_natural_armor: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide nke m - eto ero ero gbasiri ike na-eme ka ihe ọ bụla na-emerụ ahụ dị nro.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_daylight_dama: Na-emebi 1 n'otu nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-ekpuchi ya.
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.name: Oyi kpọnwụrụ
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.description: Otu elemental nke ice na oyi - freezes ndị iro, na-eme nke ọma na taigas, ma ọkụ na Nether na-agbawa obi.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_freeze_aura.d: Na-agbawa ndị iro dị nso na oke nwayọ. Na-eri ume 2. 10-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_cold_buff.des: Na-enweta ike mgbe ọ nọ na oyi taiga biomes.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_fire_weakness: Na-emebi mmebi okpukpu abụọ site na ọkụ.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.name: Ise ije
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.desc: Debe ice na ngọngọ ị na-elele. 1-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_natural_armor: Nguzogide M na-adịgide adịgide - ice kristal na-eme ka ihe ọ bụla ghara imebi ya.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_nether_damage: Na-ewere mmebi 2 kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na Nether.
origins.neoorigins.strider.name: Strider
origins.neoorigins.strider.description: Ihe e kere eke nke na-aga n'elu lava na-agwọ ọrịa na-ekpo ọkụ - mana oyi na-atụ n'ofe ụwa na mmiri na-akụnwụ.
power.neoorigins.strider_fire_immunity.d: Na-egbochi ọkụ, lava, magma blocks, na ọkụ.
power.neoorigins.strider_nether_buff.des: Na-enweta nkwalite ọsọ ọsọ mgbe ọ nọ na Nether.
Na-ewere mmebi 2 kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo.
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.name: Mgbake Magma
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.desc: Na-agwọ 2 HP kwa sekọnd ka mmiri na-emikpu n'ime lava.
power.neoorigins.strider_night_vision.de: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.strider_overworld_slown: Ji nwayọọ nwayọọ na oyi overworld.
power.neoorigins.strider_natural_armor.d: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide I - magma siri ike akpụkpọ ahụ na-ewepụ mmetụta.
origins.neoorigins.siren.name: Siren
origins.neoorigins.siren.description: An aquatic enchantress a mụrụ na oghe oké osimiri - amara e kere eke na ihe na-adọrọ adọrọ ọnụnọ na-agwọkwa na tides, ma adịghị ike, ngwa ngwa, na nkụ n'ala.
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.name: Ọnụnọ Na-adọrọ adọrọ
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.description: Ndị otu niile na-eleghara gị anya ma ọ bụrụ na ị bu ụzọ buso ha agha.
power.neoorigins.siren_water_breathing.d: Na-eku ume n'okpuru mmiri ruo mgbe ebighị ebi ma na-ahụ nke ọma site na mmiri na-enweghị foogu.
power.neoorigins.siren_aquatic_speed.des: Na-egwu mmiri ngwa ngwa karịa onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.name: Anya mmiri
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.desc: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ime omimi gbara ọchịchịrị. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.siren_reduced_health.de: -2 obi (-4 max HP). Slender, song-wuru - emebeghị maka ịkụ ọkpọ.
power.neoorigins.siren_regen_in_water.de: Na-agwọkwa 1 HP kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na mmiri.
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.name: Na-akpọnwụ
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.descrip: Ikuku na-ada mgbe ị na-apụ na mmiri: elu dị ogologo karịa ma ị kubie ume. Mmiri ozuzo, ite mmiri, iku ume mmiri ma ọ bụ ọwa mmiri na-arụ ọrụ dị nso na-egbochi ya.
origins.neoorigins.piglin.name: Piglin
origins.neoorigins.piglin.description: Onye agha Nether nwere ọla edo - dị ike n'ụlọ, ndị ikwu na-atụ egwu, mana ike gwụrụ na mpụga Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.name: Iwe iwe
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.desc: Nweta Ike II mgbe ọ nọ na Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_gold_affinity.de: Piglins na Piglin Brutes agaghị ebuso gị agha.
power.neoorigins.piglin_fire_immunity.de: Na-egbochi ọkụ, lava, magma blocks, na mmebi niile na-ere ọkụ.
power.neoorigins.piglin_overworld_weakne: Na-enwe adịghị ike mgbe ọ nọ n'ụwa.
power.neoorigins.piglin_night_vision.des: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.piglin_soul_fire_damage: Ọkụ mkpụrụ obi na-ere ọkụ karị - na-ewe mmebi 0.5 kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na Ndagwurugwu Mkpụrụ Obi Sand.
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.name: Ịkwa akwa
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.description: Ahụhụ dị ka aṅụ nke na-efe efe n'efu, na-agba ndị iro na-egbu egbu egbu, ma na-amanye ihe ọkụkụ ka ha too. Nku na-esighi ike na agụụ na-adịghị agwụ agwụ bụ ọnụ ahịa ụgbọ elu.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.name: Wings na-eme mkpọtụ
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.descrip: Na-efegharị dị ka onye ọrụ elytra - nku aṅụ na-akụ ngwa ngwa. Pịa na-awụli elu ka ị na-ada ka ọ pụọ.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.name: Agụ egbu egbu
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.descript: Na-agba ọkụ na-egbu egbu na ebumnuche gị. Na-efu 1 ume. 6-nke abụọ cooldown.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_crop_growth.de: Ihe ọkụkụ dị nso na-eto ngwa ngwa n'ihu gị.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_size.name: Obere Frame
power.neoorigins.hiveling_entity_group.d: Nkewa dị ka arthropod - adịghị ike na Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_jump_boost.des: + 40% na-awụli elu - ụkwụ aṅụ na-ebuli gị elu.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_reduced_health: -3 obi (-6 max HP). Nku na-emebi emebi, etiti na-emebi emebi.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_hunger_drain.d: Na-ere ọkụ 50% ngwa ngwa - ife efe na-agwụ ike.
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.name: Cinderborn
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.descriptio: Ọkụ ọkụ na-agbọpụta ugwu - nke ọkụ anaghị emetụta ya, anụ ọhịa na-atụ egwu, ma lava gwọọ ya - mana mmiri mebiri ya.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fire_immunit: Na-egbochi ọkụ, lava, magma blocks, na ọkụ - ọkụ na-eyi akpụkpọ ya.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fireball.des: Na-atụfu obere bọọlụ ọkụ 4 n'ụzọ ị na-achọ. Na-eri ume 3. 5-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_natural_armo: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide I - mkpuchi magma jụrụ oyi na-atụgharị ngwa agha.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_lava_regen.d: Na-agwọ 1 HP kwa sekọnd ka mmiri na-emikpu n'ime lava.
Enweta ike mgbe ọ nọ na Nether - ala ụlọ na-agba ọkụ.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_water_weakne: Mmiri bụ nsi - na-ewe 1.5 mmebi kwa sekọnd mgbe na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_night_vision: Ọkụ dị n'ime na-enye ìhè ọbụna n'ọgba ndị gbara ọchịchịrị. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_scare_mobs.d: Ọtụtụ ihe e kere eke na-agafe agafe - anụ ụlọ, ndị obodo, anụ ọhịa - gbanarị ọnụnọ gị dị ọkụ.
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.name: Akpụkpọ anụ
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.description: Ịbụ nke ọchịchịrị miri emi - nke nwere ngwa agha, nke na-eguzogide ọgwụ, na onye nwere ike ụda - mana ọ na-adịghị ngwa ngwa, adịghị ike n'ìhè anyanwụ, na ike gwụrụ n'elu ala.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_sonic_bolt.de: Na-agba ọkụ bolt sonic na-emebi emebi nke dabara na radius mgbochi 7. Na-eri ume 2. 6-nke abụọ cooldown.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_darkness_aura: Na-agba ọkụ ụda ụda ụda nke na-ahapụ ubi ọchịchịrị na-adịte aka na edemede ya. Na-eri ume 3. 15-nkeji oyi.
Na-aghọta ụwa site na vibrations - ọchịchịrị abụghị ihe mgbochi. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_natural_armor: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide I - nnukwu ọkpụkpụ ọkpụkpụ na-enweta mmebi na-abata.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_daylight_dama: Na-emebi 2 kwa nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-ekpughere ya.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_projectile_im: A na-eji mpaghara ịma jijiji na-atụgharị akụ.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_vibration_sen: Ihe ndị dị ndụ dị nso na-egbuke egbuke - ị na-enwe mmetụta ha na-agagharị n'ala.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_reduced_healt: -2 obi (-4 max HP). Ahụ nke e ji ọkpụkpụ kpụọ nke ọkara mere na-akụjikpọ.
origins.neoorigins.enderite.name: Enderite
origins.neoorigins.enderite.description: A mụrụ na njedebe - nna ukwu nke teleportation na phasing, mara mma na agbụrụ, mana adịghị ike na mmiri na ìhè ehihie.
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.name: Nzọụkwụ Warp
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.descr: Na-ebugharị ihe ruru ngọngọ 32 n'ụzọ ị na-achọ. Na-efu ike 2. 3-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.name: Usoro efu
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.descript: Usoro site na mgbidi siri ike. Na-efu ike 3. 10-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.name: Ọdịda nwayọọ Ender
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.desc: Daa nke ọma, dị ka a ga-asị na ike ndọda adịghị emetụta.
power.neoorigins.enderite_night_vision.d: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.enderite_scare_endermit: Endermites na azụ̀ ọlaọcha na-agbapụ n'ihu.
power.neoorigins.enderite_water_damage.d: Na-ewe mmebi 2 kwa nkeji site na kọntaktị na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo.
power.neoorigins.enderite_daylight_weakn: Na-enweta mmebi 50% karịa mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-ekpughere ya.
